claim: Montes Diaz et al. reported that dimethyl fumarate treatment in MS is associated with persistent changes in innate and adaptive immune-cell composition.
future_grounding_route: Use as source-specific cell-composition context when checking whether validation cohorts require composition diagnostics or deconvolution; do not treat as evidence about the locked V22 scalar.

project_finding_reference.finding_id: V22 scalar is immune-tone bounded, not steroid/composition artifact

project_use: Sharper V50 source record supporting the necessity of cell-composition diagnostics around DMF response data.
relationship_note: This source supports cell-composition shift as a real DMF-related confounder class, but it does not test the V22 APC/HLA-II scalar.

source.citation: Montes Diaz G, Fraussen J, Van Wijmeersch B, Hupperts R, Somers V. Dimethyl fumarate induces a persistent change in the composition of the innate and adaptive immune system in multiple sclerosis patients. Scientific Reports. 2018;8:8194.
source.label: Montes Diaz 2018 DMF immune-cell composition study

source_terms.license_or_terms_label: Open-access Scientific Reports article; metadata-only reuse in V50
source_terms.reuse_notes: V50 stores source metadata and a short paraphrased claim only.

why_unverifiable: The project has not rerun the immune-phenotyping data or mapped composition shifts to V22 module behavior.
